literature_notes: Both ledger lines describe intracellular insertions. L1 (PMC8100128) places three tandem FLAG epitopes at the C-terminus of full-length ADAM17; the C-terminus (residue 824) lies within the intracellular domain (692–824) and is therefore cytoplasmic. L2 (PMC8191336) places an HA-tag after residue 699 ('following DKKLD699'), explicitly described as 'immediately C-terminal to the transmembrane domain'; residue 699 is 8 residues into the intracellular domain (692–824) and is cytoplasmic. ADAM17 has a large extracellular domain (residues 18–671) and a single-pass type-I topology, but no ledger line reports a tag insertion anywhere in that extracellular span. Zero extracellular surface tag sites are supported by the ledger.
